(Except to Co-op members) |museum = yes |museum_xp = 4 |museum_category = fishing |soulbound = Co-op }} The '''Starter Lava Rod''' is an {{Uncommon}} Lava [[Fishing Rod]]. == Obtaining == The '''Starter Lava Rod''' is obtained by talking to {{NPCSprite|Odger}} in the {{zone|Crimson Isle}} at the top of the {{Zone|Blazing Volcano}}. He will give the player one for free on their first interaction. They can be bought later for {{C|10k}} from Odger. == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Fishing Rod |name = Starter Lava Rod |rarity = u |damage = 50 |trophy_fish_chance = 5 |strength = 50 |fishing_speed = 10 |trophy_chance = 5 }} The '''Starter Lava Rod''' can be used to fish in [[Lava]]. It requires {{Skill|Fishing|10}} to be used. A '''Starter Lava Rod''' with no enchantments can be used to fish up Vanille [[Trophy Fish]]. == Tips == *Unless going for the Vanille [[Trophy Fish]], it is recommended to use a {{Item|Topaz Rod}} instead if the player has reached {{Skill|Fishing|19}} and {{Coll|Heart of the Mountain|5}} but not {{Skill|Fishing|27}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 8|[[File:Starter Lava Rod (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Starter Lava Rod'''.}} {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Starter Lava Rod (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Starter Lava Rod''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Starter Lava Rod (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Starter Lava Rod'''.}} {{History|0.14|Now gives {{stat|fishing speed|+8}}.}} {{History|2024/Jul 2|Buffed from {{stat|dmg|50}} to {{stat|dmg|100}}.}} {{History|0.22|Adjusted stats: *{{Stat|Damage}}: 100 → 50 *{{Stat|Trophy Chance}}: 0 → 5 *{{Stat|Fishing Speed}}: 8 → 10|Added {{Green|1x}} Aquamarine [[Gemstone Slot]].}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Starter Lava Rod (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Starter Lava Rod''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Fishing}} {{Nav/Tools/Fishing}} {{Nav/Crimson Isle}} [[Category:Fishing Rods]]
